header.description: What: CE-4649 part C (AN-20a/b/c/d; docs/designs/animals/DESIGN_Animals.md 4b) re-authored for part D (AN-21g) - on the farm terrain two HUNTERS (Friend, type 214: the 12-gauge only, a STANDING rule to engage ducks, never people - no order is given) stand 30 m west of a lone duck and of a duck flock (one entity drawn as 30 birds), each hovering 8 m up ('Hunter Lone' (100,100) / duck (130,100); 'Hunter Flock' (100,200) / flock (130,200)). Judge: (1) the lone duck's health is 0 and it lies on the ground (z near 0) (2) the flock's count drops by at least one (3) a dead duck lies where the flock was hit (4) the flock flees (it flies). Pellets, not rifle rounds. All points are inside 0-300 m. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh an-duck-hunt
